title: Ordered coordinate differences regularly generate the affine diagonal locally
statement: Let Y be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], let d be a natural number, and write X for its ordered affine d-space tower with projection p [def-amb-affine-trace-tower]. For every point z of X there is an affine open U of X ×_Y X [def-pc-fibre-product] containing Δ_p(z), such that the restrictions f_i of p₂*(x_i)−p₁*(x_i), i in Fin d, form a regular sequence in Γ(U,O_U) [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], and their span is precisely the diagonal kernel ideal on U [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. No normal cone, associated graded algebra or relative spectrum occurs in this assertion. It applies to arbitrary base rings; empty Y is permitted and d=0 means the empty regular sequence on a nonempty affine neighborhood of z.

source.place: Agreement on the model: the diagonal has the trivial normal bundle in ordered difference coordinates; expanded polynomial calculation of parent proof step 5

proof.text: Choose an affine open Spec R of Y containing p(z). Polynomial base-change charts for affine space and the canonical coordinate isomorphism for the tower identify the self-product over this open with Spec R[x,y], an ambient affine open U containing Δ_p(z). The restriction of each prescribed global difference is exactly y_i−x_i.

The polynomial substitution u_i=y_i−x_i, inverse y_i=x_i+u_i, identifies the diagonal ring map with evaluation at u=0 on R[x,u]. Its kernel is the ideal (u): expand a polynomial into its constant term plus the sum of all positive-degree monomials, each divisible by one variable. Successively quotienting by initial variables leaves the polynomial ring in the remaining variables. Comparing coefficients proves that multiplication by the next variable is injective. The final quotient is R[x], nonzero because its spectrum contains z. This proves regularity and the asserted kernel equality. For d=0 the kernel is zero; there are no points to check over an empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem affineDiagonal_regular_differences (Y : Scheme.{u}) (d : ℕ)
    (z : affineTraceTower Y d) :
    ∃ U : (pullback (affineTraceProjection Y d) (affineTraceProjection Y d)).affineOpens,
      (pullback.diagonal (affineTraceProjection Y d)) z ∈ U.1 ∧
      let f : Fin d → Γ(pullback (affineTraceProjection Y d) (affineTraceProjection Y d),
          U.1) := fun j ↦
        (pullback (affineTraceProjection Y d) (affineTraceProjection Y d)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (show U.1 ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
          ((pullback.snd (affineTraceProjection Y d) (affineTraceProjection Y d)).appTop
              (affineTraceCoordinate Y d j) -
            (pullback.fst (affineTraceProjection Y d) (affineTraceProjection Y d)).appTop
              (affineTraceCoordinate Y d j))
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular Γ(pullback (affineTraceProjection Y d)
          (affineTraceProjection Y d), U.1) (List.ofFn f) ∧
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) =
          (pullback.diagonal (affineTraceProjection Y d)).ker.ideal U
